title: How Many Different ORs
statement:
Take every non-empty contiguous block of the list `a_1 ... a_n` and compute the bitwise OR of its elements. Print how many different values appear among all these ORs.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the number of different OR values.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
